text: In the Reissner-Nordström solution, the inner horizon at r_− — where determinism breaks down and infalling radiation is infinitely blueshifted — is called the ___ horizon.
explanation: The book calls the inner horizon r_− the Cauchy horizon: the domain of dependence of any initial-data surface does not extend past it, and infalling radiation is infinitely blueshifted there (Strong Cosmic Censorship suggests it is unstable). The outer horizon r_+ is the ordinary event horizon.
